name: Exzeo Group Inc. Common Stock
summary: Exzeo Group, Inc. offers complete technology and operational services tailored for insurance carriers and agents. The core of their offering is an Insurance-as-a-Service (IaaS) platform designed to streamline essential administrative and operational tasks. These capabilities encompass everything from accurate quoting and underwriting to efficient policy lifecycle management, rapid claims processing, and comprehensive data and financial reporting. The company specifically focuses on serving the property and casualty (P&C) insurance market. Founded in 2012 and based in Tampa, Florida, Exzeo Group, Inc. was formerly recognized as TypTap Insurance Group, Inc. It operates under the umbrella of its parent company, HCI Group, Inc.
